Author: Minescence
Name: Fur Renderer
Description: Grows hundreds of thousands of skinned hair strands on any worn item or minion whose mod uses Hikari's fur textures, and draws them with the GPU. Follows the dye and the scene's light. Only you see it. The mods aren't included.
Punchline: Real strand fur on items that use Hikari's fur textures.
Changelog: Fur colour follows each item's live colour table and textures per strand, so dye changes show without regrowing. Hidden and off-screen strands are skipped and far items draw fewer strands. Settings explain themselves on hover and reset from a right-click menu. Fixes from a code audit.
